objective: Verified shippable data-driven visual novel runtime
note: 100/100 original scoped MVP acceptance criteria verified on 2026-10-27 (CI main run 40571573177, commit e9a9a9c). Tested player, external assets, narrative, typography, audio decode, timed fades, save/load, safe hot reload, relocatable Linux packaging, both endings, and clean shutdown. Audio through a physical sound device was not tested in headless CI; requires optional platform-specific hardware QA.
